messages:
sasha: Heads-up — after the 03:12 UTC frontend/proxy deploy, the latency dashboard is missing p95 and p99 lines for prod. p50/p90 still render. Screenshot: https://redwood.screens/abc123 :eyes:
deploy-bot: Deployment succeeded: release/2026-03-17/fe-proxy @ 03:12 by jorge :white_check_mark:
jorge: Thx. Any errors in metrics ingest or grafana logs? Mei, can you look at the aggregator and viz layer?
mei: Checking now. No obvious 5xx on ingest. Grafana logs show many "series not found" warnings for metric "redwood.request_latency_seconds" with label quantile=\"0.95\". Looks like queries are returning NaN arrays.
rahul: Ran a quick PromQL against prometheus: 
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, service, env))
```
returns series for p50/p90 but empty for 0.95/0.99 in the UI. Raw /api/v1/query_range shows values for buckets, so backend has data.
lina: Customer support flagged 3 incidents where customers saw "latency tail missing" pages. They're asking for ETA.
jorge: Could the frontend dashboard query have a new label selector? We rolled a small change to the viz templating yesterday.
mei: I grep'd the dashboard JSON in git: the panel for p95 references label filter `quantile="95th"` (string) instead of the histogram_quantile calcs. That doesn't match our prometheus labels. The panel likely fell back to the series name, which no longer exists.
rahul: Confirmed — earlier we had a compatibility shim in the ingest transform that emitted a pre-computed series named `redwood_latency_quantiles{quantile="95th"}`, but that transform was removed in fe-proxy deploy (PR #4123) to avoid double counting. Dashboards still relied on it.
jorge: Oof. So two issues: the shim removal (intended) + dashboard still wired to shim. Close coupling.
mei: Quick mitigation: I can patch the dashboard to use histogram_quantile() instead of the deleted series. Will push a grafana dash hotfix in 10m.
sasha: Thanks — customers are seeing confusing UI. Any way to mark the dashboard as degraded while we fix?
lina: I'll update the support tickets and add a note in status.redwood.ai indicating latency-graphs degraded for prod UI.
deploy-bot: Action scheduled: grafana-hotfix/patch-quantile-panel by mei in 10m.
rahul: After hotfix, verify queries:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_request_latency_seconds_bucket{service="api",env="prod"}[5m])) by (le))
```
returns sensible numbers in prom. Will monitor for 15m post-patch.
mei: Hotfix applied at 03:34 UTC. I adjusted the panels to use histogram_quantile and added a note in dashboard changelog.
sasha: Confirmed — p95/p99 lines are back on the dashboard for prod. Thanks all. :tada:
jorge: Follow-up: file an infra task to avoid dashboard reliance on ephemeral shim. I'll open a ticket to either restore long-term metrics or change dashboards permanently.
lina: Updated tickets and posted to #status with a link to updated dash.
rahul: I'll leave an alert to detect missing quantiles in UI vs backend for next 48h.
mei: Closing thread once alerts are green.
